name: Kaito Kurai
source:
One of the six boys newly arrived in the town of Rosalind. He attends the same school as the protagonist and seems to be strangely interested in her/him/them.

He's a very smart and studious student but is arrogant. He is cold and contemptuous towards the protagonist at the time of their first meeting, but gradually softens.
